text_block_list.text:
Today is interview day. A reporter is scheduled
to visit the academy in three hours, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
......Hey.
The setting sun is displeasing. Deal with it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Tch...

—Of all days, Orfevre had to be in
an extraordinarily foul mood...!
choice_data_list: (I have to do something before the reporters get here!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Steak.
I desire steak.
choice_data_list: Um... steak isn't on the menu, though.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...So what?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Tell me one thing.
Why do your legs exist?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
In whose service do you lay down your life?
—Answer me.
choice_data_list: I-I'll go buy it right away!! In a flash!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ......Boring.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What insolence. To put a king to work, making him earn daily wages.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Why is it missing?
From the list of occupations—'King.'"
choice_data_list: Oh, how about we make an original one? That profession

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Enough.
Take it away.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Now, make haste and present it.
The next amusement.
In the end, without being able to put Orfevre in a better mood, interview time drew near—and on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'm so sorry! It was my carelessness!
Orfe-san's tail is...!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: I-I have a towel, let me wipe it off!
I-I have a towel, let me wipe it off!

text_block_list.text:
I carefully wipe Orfevre's tail,
which had gotten wet with orange juice.
...At that moment, a memory came back to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—You fool.
You touched it, didn't you? The King's tail.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, not at all...!
Our hands just brushed against each other a little...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You deserve ten thousand deaths.
Prostrate yourself and apologize.
choice_data_list: (......I might have really messed up this time!)

text_block_list.text:
I frantically apologize for touching her tail.
To which Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ah, you may dispense with formalities.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Because I'm in that sort of mood, you see.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So the secret to your strength,
Orfevre-san, is the fruit of your daily devotion!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. I am a King.
Therefore, I desire only hardship worthy of me.
choice_data_list: (Thank goodness... she's really in a better mood!)

text_block_list.text: To be honest, I had no idea what had triggered her mood swing, but—unbeknownst to anyone, I let out a sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, we'd also like to ask Orfe-san's
Trainer for a few words!
choice_data_list: I will continue to serve her with all my strength!
I'll get stronger so I can provide even better support!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed.
That is your duty."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A king needs loyal retainers.
Never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, come to think of it.
I haven't told you yet, have I?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Thy devotion on this occasion was commendable.
—Continue thy diligent efforts without faltering.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph... What an obvious thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
“However, it is good. You stated it publicly—
you proclaimed it. That is worthy of praise.”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Devote yourself diligently,
so that you do not become all talk."
